components.name: Native button
components.description: Plugin geometry for a host-native button. Obsidian owns its paint, corner shape, hover and disabled styling; this snippet does not invent replacements.

components.name: Native search field
components.description: Host-native search with the dashboard's flexible sizing and visible keyboard focus.

components.name: Chart controls
components.description: Wrapping native Fit/zoom buttons and optional year lines. Source behavior saves the year-line setting per composition with rollback on failure.

components.name: Shared-scale chart frame
components.description: Flat scroll frame and sticky 38px ruler. The renderer uses a minimum 1000px plot and 24px or 160px sticky gutter; horizontal overflow is intentional.

components.name: Category, stream and item hierarchy
components.description: Default full heights are 88px category, 40px stream and 14px item, with a shared centerline. The category is behind the stream, keeps its own layer color and endpoint, and has a 6px radius on flat stretches. Curved stretches follow the anchor centerline at constant category thickness. Height overrides are 8–240px; integrated boxes retain at least 12px clearance above and below their stream. Lane-center spacing is max(max(192px, 2h + 80px) × 2/3, 2h + 24px), where h is the largest reserved half-height: 128px by default, with a tall-category safety floor. First-lane placement, shape heights, fonts and 22px name-rail spacing are unchanged. Optional contour mode preserves the earlier exact-contour overlay and dashed continuation treatment.

components.name: Aligned record name
components.description: Unboxed name, orthogonal leader and transparent focus backing. Leaders paint behind historical shapes so they do not cross diamond faces; names remain above the shapes. Stream names sit 7px outside the lower stream edge; category names start 7px inside the category's upper edge. Attached names clear the full category extent and use up to four 22px-spaced rail levels. Try full titles in collision-free local space first; point labels may use any open vertical rail within a bounded 320px neighborhood centered on the date, without midpoint partitions. Existing labels block overlaps and leaders preserve the exact marker date. Abbreviate only when no local slot fits, without creating historical lanes.

components.name: Quiet bounded context
components.description: Optional separate context strip: 32px default height, 4px corner radius, fine separator and configured opacity multiplied by 0.18; layers have 16px separation. A lane-placed band instead defaults to 88px with a 6px radius and configured opacity. Height overrides apply to either placement. Location and extent come from record dates, not the preview geometry.

components.name: Point, event and cluster markers
components.description: Equal-coordinate non-anchor box/stream/line records use 18px date-pinned diamonds, never stretched intervals; real nonzero durations and 5px-radius dot-style events retain their shapes. Nearby points keep exact date x-positions and fan vertically at −10/+10px for two or −20/0/+20px for three positions, with short pins back to each actual curve. More than three retain the first two individual records and a selectable 20px diamond overflow group. Individual hit rectangles are 44×44px alone or 44×20px crowded, with no rectangle focus stroke. Diamond outlines use contrastText(layer.color) via --vt-marker-outline; host-text focus/selection strokes remain unchanged. Other clusters remain 10px-radius circles. Counts use 11px/700 type and choose black or white per configured six-digit hex fill using linearized sRGB luminance, threshold 0.179. Activating a cluster lists every member.

components.name: Selection strip and narrow sheet
components.description: Full title and metadata with separate Open note/Close actions and a collapsed relationship disclosure. SVG accessible names use aria-labelledby linked to one uniquely-ID'd native title per surface, shape or name, avoiding Obsidian's HTML-only tooltip dispatch on SVG; HTML control labels stay unchanged. Shape titles include the full record name and recorded date, while visible-name targets retain the full name. Year-precision points show the single recorded year, preserve any existing circa modifier and state 'Year precision · exact duration not recorded'. The renderer focuses the heading on open, restores focus on close and handles Escape. At a 650px chart-container width it becomes a safe-area-aware fixed sheet; this is implemented responsive behavior, not real iOS verification.

components.name: Layer editor group
components.description: Native disclosure group on the secondary surface; a 10px corner radius distinguishes it from 8px chart/selection frames. Height accepts 8–240px or blank for automatic defaults, and category shape offers box or optional legacy contour. These additive composition-version-2 display fields do not require note or settings-file migrations. No decorative card shadow.

narrative.northStar: Historical continuity with disciplined adjacent name rails
narrative.overview:
The built explorer preserves the user-approved flowing-stream direction and aligned-name-rail structure. Broad continuity ribbons lead; attached durations and their boundaries come next; adjacent names and selection supply individual detail. Taller translucent category boxes sit behind the streams, with item bars centered inside the streams. This is a native Obsidian tool, not an illustrated history poster or a separate branded application shell.

The host supplies light or dark surfaces, interface typography and native controls. Fixed-pixel chart geometry keeps labels, ribbon thickness and vertical spacing stable while the horizontal time scale changes. Real dense records may need four name-rail levels, abbreviated labels and selectable clusters; the illustrative mockup is not authority for dates, missing records or exact geometry. This document describes the implementation, not pixel-perfect mockup fidelity or real iOS verification. The earlier automatic full-page comparison remains nonpassing; this approved component refinement does not mark that gate passed.
keyCharacteristics: Host-theme surfaces and native interface typography.
Flowing continuity ribbons with explicit attachment semantics.
Taller background categories, separate streams and centered item bars.
Fixed-pixel geometry and adjacent, unboxed name rails.
Quiet, bounded context and selection-led full detail.
Configurable rows, layers, colors and display styles.

rules.name: The Host-Theme Rule
rules.body: Preserve Obsidian's active theme; no fixed dark canvas, imported font or example palette is required.

rules.name: The Stable-Label Rule
rules.body: Zoom the time axis, not the font or vertical geometry. Try the full name inside collision-free space in that item's nearby temporal neighborhood first. Point labels may use open vertical rails anywhere within a bounded 320px neighborhood centered on their date; do not divide that space at adjacent-event midpoints, which can collapse to a few pixels when dates cluster. Existing labels still block overlaps, and leaders preserve the exact marker date. Duration and category names may use their own recorded span. Only abbreviate when no local slot can hold the title, truncating at a complete-word boundary and splitting a single long word only as a last resort. Selection and accessible labels always retain the full title.

dos: Do preserve the host theme, interface font and native controls.
Do preserve explicit succession and attachment semantics while making boundaries and names legible.
Do keep text and vertical geometry fixed in screen pixels while zooming the shared time axis.
Do use up to four aligned name-rail levels, abbreviation, clusters and selection for real dense records.
Do keep context bounded and subordinate, with full detail available separately.
Do calculate cluster numeral contrast against its configured marker fill.
Do keep integrated category boxes taller than streams, centered behind them and independent of stream end dates; retain contour mode as an explicit option.
Do pin equal-coordinate duration-style records to their exact date with diamonds, preserving true intervals and ordinary event dots.
Do use compact lane spacing with the custom-category safety floor, without shrinking shapes, fonts or name rails.
donts: Don't force a dark theme or make the example history's colors universal.
Don't turn label collisions into invented historical lanes or relationships.
Don't give resting name labels button backplates or replace continuity ribbons with disconnected cards.
Don't hide records merely because their full names cannot fit in an overview.
Don't shorten category end dates to stream endpoints or treat context-only extent as a historical successor.
Don't stretch a year-precision point into a historical interval or move its date horizontally to resolve crowding.
Don't reproduce illustrative mockup chronology or claim pixel-perfect fidelity or real iOS verification from this design record.
